Human system: Small independent installations grouped under Access networks. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Return Exchange compares traces after absence rather than treating every gap as death.
It remains functioning in the current placement. Delayed transfers may carry damaged material long after the originating disruption.
